correctness.rationale: For any alphabet q>=2 and received word length m>=4, legal inverse sites are occurrences of abba. If deleting two middle letters at different sites yields the same parent, direct word comparison forces period two between sites; legality of both palindromic windows forces the entire intervening interval constant. Consequently all constant 4-windows of a long run give a single parent, and every interior run of length two with equal-symbol flanks contributes exactly one distinct nonconstant window. Disjoint-run length budgets give max floor((m-2)/2), achieved by alternating runs of lengths 1,2,...,2,1. Counting nonconstant abba windows plus starts of runs >=4 gives sum_y d(y) = q^(m-4)*((m-3)q(q-1)+q+(m-4)(q-1)). An independent direct inverse enumeration checked q=2,m=4..11 and q=3,m=4..7; it is not an infinite proof.
residual_risks: Independent bounded calculations corroborate but do not prove infinite quantifiers; the reviewed mathematical proof is the universal argument.
